headline: How I Can Help
subheadline: From custom web builds to enterprise systems work — practical software help scoped to what your business actually needs.

offerings.title: Custom Web & App Development
offerings.description: Design-led websites and web applications that convert — from marketing sites to full custom internal tools. Built with Blazor, Angular, or Astro depending on what the project actually calls for.
includes: UI/UX design in Figma before a line of code
offerings.engagement: Project-based, scoped after a free discovery call.

offerings.title: ERP & Business Systems Consulting
offerings.description: Full-stack development and integration work for organizations running on complex systems — data pipelines, CRM/ERP sync, secure internal tools, and the reporting people actually rely on.
offerings.engagement: Hourly or retainer, depending on scope and duration.

offerings.title: AI-Assisted Development & Modernization
offerings.description: Bringing AI-assisted workflows into existing codebases — faster iteration, better documentation, safer refactors — without sacrificing code quality or understanding of what's actually being shipped.

offerings.title: Ongoing Support & Maintenance
offerings.description: Keeping your systems updated, patched, and running smoothly — so you're not firefighting when something breaks.

faqs.question: What does it cost to hire you for a web development project?
faqs.answer: It depends on the type of engagement. Custom web/app development projects typically run $750–$3,000, priced per project after scoping. ERP and business systems consulting runs $125–$175/hr. AI-assisted development and codebase modernization runs $100–$150/hr. Ongoing support and maintenance is a $300–$800/month retainer.

faqs.question: How does an engagement actually start?
faqs.answer: With a free discovery call to scope what you actually need. From there it's priced project-based, hourly, or as a monthly retainer, whichever fits the work — not a fixed package pushed onto every client.

faqs.question: What kind of projects do you take on?
faqs.answer: Design-led marketing sites and custom web applications (built in Blazor, Angular, or Astro depending on what the project calls for), ERP/CRM integrations and secure data pipelines, AI-assisted legacy codebase modernization, and ongoing maintenance for systems already in production.

faqs.question: Do you offer support after a project ships?
faqs.answer: Yes — ongoing support and maintenance is available as a monthly retainer, covering regular updates and security patches, bug fixes and small enhancements, and uptime/performance monitoring, with direct access rather than a ticket queue.
